Class Player

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.user.User
pt.ipp.isep.dei.domain.Player
public class Player extends User
Represents a player in the system. A player has a username, password, budget, a list of owned locomotives, and a list of owned trains.

Supports core actions for buying locomotives (US9), creating and managing trains (US10, US11).
